name: Corinna
beschreibung: Hotel Corinna is centrally located yet quiet in the center of Ischgl. The Silvrettabahn is just a few minutes' walk away, making access to the ski areas easier. The house combines traditional Tiroler style with modern comfort. The wellness area includes an indoor pool, several saunas and steam baths. Half board includes an evening multi-course menu. The rooms are spacious and mostly have a balcony with mountain views. Guests looking for a quiet, well-kept atmosphere and who value service and cuisine will feel at home here. The hotel is particularly suitable for couples and families who want a relaxing stay.
